Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add admin ability to permanently delete payment slips with status recalculation

1. DELETE endpoint for payment slips \(/api/payments/[slipId]\)
   - Admin-only access \(requires admin:access permission\)
   - Requires deletion reason for audit trail
   - Permanently removes slip from database

     * Remaining: Resets to "รอชำระยอดคงเหลือ"

   - Button works for all slip statuses \(pending, approved, rejected\)

   - Changed "ลบ" to "ปฏิเสธ" for reject action \(clearer naming\)

- Deletes slip even if already approved
- Automatically recalculates payment completion status
- Updates registration status if no longer fully paid
- Clears slip URLs and payment dates
- Maintains data integrity across collections

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: Fix room assignment message to show all roommates and send to all selected registrations

Fixed two critical issues with room assignment LINE messages:

Issue 1: Roommates from other registrations not showing
- Root cause: Only searching for roommates within selectedRegistrations
  \(only checked items\), not all event registrations
- Fix: Fetch all event registrations before processing room assignments
- Now searches entire event database to find roommates in same room
- Added comprehensive logging to trace roommate lookup process

Issue 2: Test send only sending to first selected registration
- Root cause: throw Error\(\) in loop breaks iteration on first failure
- Fix: Changed from throw to continue with error logging
- Now processes all selected registrations even if some fail
- Added warning in success toast if some messages failed
- Shows count of successful vs total messages

Technical Changes:
- Added allEventRegistrations fetch in handleSend\(\)
- Added allEventRegistrationsForTest fetch in handleTestSend\(\)
- Changed from throw to continue in all test send error handlers
- Updated success toasts to show partial failure warnings
- Improved error logging with specific prefixes per message type

Both regular send and test send now:
✅ Show ALL roommates from ANY registration in same room
✅ Send to ALL selected registrations \(continue on failure\)
✅ Display accurate success/failure counts
✅ Log detailed errors for troubleshooting
